summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of Starter Library Onboarding feature - Backend 15/15 tests passed (100%), Frontend all critical flows verified. Onboarding modal correctly shows for users with <5 diary entries, uses TMDB popular movies for variety (~29 unique cards), rating popup design is clean with 0-10 slider (step 0.5), progress bar increments live (2/5 -> 3/5), toast confirms 'X more to go', skip persists state but modal re-appears since diary_count still <5. Auth, watch history, and home sections working.
passed_tests: Backend: /api/onboarding/eligibility requires auth (401)
Backend: /api/onboarding/eligibility returns full schema (eligible, diary_count, watchlist_count, onboarding_skipped, onboarding_completed, minimum_required=5, movies_needed)
Backend: movies_needed = max(0, 5 - diary_count) consistency
Backend: eligible == (diary_count < 5) consistency
Backend: /api/onboarding/popular-movies returns 20-30 movies
Backend: popular-movies items have id, title, poster_url (w185)
Backend: popular-movies contains no duplicate ids
Backend: /api/onboarding/skip requires auth
Backend: /api/onboarding/skip persists onboarding_skipped=true
Backend: Skip does NOT change eligibility when diary_count < 5 (still eligible)
Backend: /api/onboarding/complete requires auth + persists onboarding_completed=true
Backend: Adding movie via /api/user/watch-history increments diary_count and decrements movies_needed
Backend: /api/user/profile and /api/movies/trending endpoints healthy
Frontend: Login flow works (email/password credentials)
Frontend: /my-movies triggers onboarding modal when diary_count < 5
Frontend: Modal title 'Build your movie taste profile' present
Frontend: Progress bar shows correct count (2 / 5 movies for user with 2 diary entries)
Frontend: 29 popular movie cards displayed (TMDB popular endpoint)
Frontend: Clicking a movie card opens clean rating popup (not crowded)
Frontend: Rating slider min=0, max=10, step=0.5, default 7.0
Frontend: 'Add to Diary' button present in popup
Frontend: After add - card shows 'Added' checkmark state
Frontend: After add - progress bar updates from 2/5 to 3/5
Frontend: Toast 'Added "Moana"! 2 more to go.' shown
Frontend: Footer chip '+1 movie added' appears
Frontend: Skip button dismisses modal (onboarding_skipped=true in DB)
Frontend: Modal RE-APPEARS on subsequent /my-movies visit since diary_count (3) < 5
Frontend: Newly added movie 'Moana' persisted in /api/user/watch-history
Frontend: Home sections load (Chef's Special, Discover, Trending)
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding_service.py: get_onboarding_eligibility returns onboarding_skipped/completed but the frontend and requestOnboarding logic never uses these flags to gate the prompt - onboarding_skipped is stored but effectively ignored (by design per spec 'doesn't prevent re-prompting'). Confirmed working as designed.

routers/onboarding.py:71-78 - 'popular_batch = unique_movies[:20]' followed by concatenating rest[:10] means order weights front-of-list popular movies but shuffles the tail; acceptable variety for onboarding UX.

StarterLibraryOnboarding.js line 332: newTotal calculation uses stale addedMovies.size (from before setAddedMovies has flushed), but since setAddedMovies is called just before and the compensation +1 is applied, the arithmetic is correct in practice. Minor code smell - would be clearer to compute after setState using functional update.

StarterLibraryOnboarding.js line 291: axios.post to /api/onboarding/skip sends {skipped: true} body but backend router uses OnboardingDismissRequest model - verify model accepts this shape (worked in E2E test, so likely fine).

Existing test file /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding.py contains outdated assertion: test_user_with_diary_not_eligible expects eligible=False for diary_count=5, which is correct per new MINIMUM=5 (< 5). Test still passes because 5 is NOT less than 5. All good.
seed_data_creation: During testing added 1 movie ('Moana') to vibetest2 diary. Final state: 3 diary entries + 1 watchlist. onboarding_skipped=true, onboarding_completed=true. Modal will still re-appear because diary_count (3) < 5 as intended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Starter Library Onboarding fully verified. Key behaviors: (1) Modal triggers when diary_count < 5 (MINIMUM_DIARY_COUNT=5 in /app/backend/services/onboarding_service.py), (2) Popular movies from TMDB /movie/popular (3 pages) + /movie/top_rated with 20 popular + 10 shuffled = 30 total, deduped, filtered against user's existing diary/watchlist client-side, (3) Rating popup uses 0-10 slider step 0.5 default 7.0 with clean single-card in-place expansion (not overlay/dialog stacking), (4) Skip button persists onboarding_skipped=true but modal re-appears on next /my-movies visit if still <5 movies (as designed), (5) Adding movie triggers POST /api/user/watch-history then POST /api/onboarding/complete. Test user vibetest2 currently has 3 diary movies - safe for future testing since still eligible. If further tests needed, cleanup movies to reset.
